shortDescription: The ultimate Metal companion for Area 53 2026. Offline maps & AI scout.
longDescription:
Prepare for battle at Area 53 Metal Festival 2026.

This is the high-performance tactical tool for the hardest weekend in Leoben. Area 53 Insider provides instant, offline-first access to the lineup, camping maps, and survival tools.

FEATURES:
- Metal Scout: AI-driven discovery for extreme metal fans.
- Schladnitz Map: Tactical grid for the VAZ Schladnitz grounds.
- Tent Finder: GPS-locked pinpointing for your campsite.
- Survival Toolkit: SOS beacon and essential safety info.
- 100% Offline: Engineered for the mountains where signal fails.

Horns up. Intelligence active.
